title: OP AND KEYLESS [OUTDATED BUT WORKS]
features:
--||AFTER EXECUTING||--
Every prompt (e.g. to Unban, Pick up) will have 0 hold time + inf range (INF RANGE DOESN'T WORK)

--|| SCANNER ||--
Will scan for the top 1-3 most money making hackers (CLICK TO TP TO THEM)

--|| AUTO FARM ||--
Will let you target one of the highest by money a sec (pickable!) hackers and will automatically get them for you. (NO NEED TO GET REBIRTHS, ITS BYPASSED)

--|| ZONE REFRESH ||-- This one is beta, sorry for issues :/
Will open (Unban) every hacker in the best (Exotic at the time of publishing this) zone and after some time they will de-spawn making new and better hackers to spawn.

--|| HITBOX ||--
Will let you automatically collect  every hacker you pick up no matter where you are.

--|| MAP CLEANUP ||--
Will delete every camera and will remove every rebirth wall barrier

This script has also debugging but its self explanatory :]
